sources.title: [Morimens] Mono chaos team guide (24/Lotan) - The unbalanceable team archetype
sources.access: English auto-caption transcript; targeted mechanics passages read, not independent video-frame verification

notes.summary: The guide connects Posse use, Realm Mastery and Aliemus generation, making resource supply part of the rotation.
Lotan's percentage-HP route favors one-bar bosses. The 24 route instead needs time and repeated Exalts.
Double-Posse plans require adequate Keyflare. A wheel or level upgrade that fixes that shortage can change feasibility.
The guide qualifies Rouse ordering by carry damage and existing Keyflare, rather than giving one universally optimal opener.

sources.engineBoundary: No automatic Chaos/Keyflare battle loop is implemented by the new threshold search. These are explicit missing dependencies.

sources.title: [Morimens] Helot: Catena Low to High Investment Detailed Guide
sources.access: English auto-caption transcript; targeted stats, investment, and burst passages read

notes.summary: Carry base-damage growth and survival time are linked; delaying death can improve the eventual burst.
Arachne's own pursuits build Wheel amplification before the carry attacks.
The guide proposes roughly 750 end-turn Keyflare for its higher-investment setup, not a universal clear threshold.
It prioritizes the carry's levels, then Arachne's defensive contribution, and treats HP as a survival input.

sources.engineBoundary: The recovered Wheel model independently enforces owner identity, five-trigger limits and after-pursuit timing; it does not reproduce this video's full battle.

sources.title: Flares' Holy Spreadsheet to Morimens V5.0 2026 G-OgierUpdate
sources.access: Bounded native reads: Starter Realm Guide A1:AW60; Basics of Teambuilding A1:Z65; STR SCALING SHEEt A1:Z35

notes.summary: Choose a carry/archetype, add enabling supports, then check reliable access to Vulnerable and Weakness.
Realm mechanics change resource, defense and turn behavior; the sheet itself warns that mastery values can change.
Published damage comparisons include different ramp times and utility; they cannot be used as matched build benchmarks.

sources.engineBoundary: Do not import tier ranks or damage totals as coefficients. Character portraits and comparison assumptions were not fully audited.

notes.summary: The wiki describes card-linked Keyflare gain and a 1000-Keyflare Posse threshold. This is orientation only; build attribution is absent.

sources.engineBoundary: No wiki coefficient is newly executed. Later or alternate realm rules require a build-specific audit.

conflictPolicy: Never blend a guide's patch-era rule, an old client runtime and a different encounter into a purported complete current-build simulation.
